requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4050-4550-5567-8298--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4050-4550-5567-8298--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

2707-4377-7654.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

455-1770-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
455-1770-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying its mana cost.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama (and up to two other target creatures) to their owners' hands.
Repeat.

1558-4840-8193.description:
Cast Myr Battlesphere by paying {7}.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Avacyn triggers, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

2178-2380-5147.easyPrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
2178-2380-5147.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Bloodline Keeper // Lord of Lineage.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

2099-4694-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-4694-6258-7306.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

443-728-3249-6006--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
443-728-3249-6006--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-2841-6926-7885.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1479-2841-6926-7885.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

345-6495--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creature's creature types is chosen with Metallic Mimic.
345-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
345-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

206-222-527-728.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-2279-2511-3125.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-2511-3125.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

2103-6991-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Donnie & April.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Donnie & April from exile to the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1477-4186-7810.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing an artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
Repeat.

3693-4613-6843-7741.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Shang-Chi.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-3019-4258.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Sedgemoor Witch
1618-2440-3019-4258.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Inspiring Refrain.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Sedgemoor Witch triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain.
Repeat.
1618-2440-3019-4258.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Sedgemoor Witch. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

3220-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3220-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1687-6798-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-5231-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-5231-6720.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1887-5902-6575--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent and Vorinclex, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3499-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1978-4002-4324.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-4324.description:
Animate Sceptre of Eternal Glory using Workshop Elders.
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat from step 2.

3946-4426-6762.notablePrerequisites: Exploration Broodship has three or more charge counters on it.
3946-4426-6762.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1753-2457-4289-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

710-1703-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

880-4871-5671.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4871-5671.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-586-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2921-3293-5282.notablePrerequisites: You have a Plains exiled by Wormfang Newt.
2921-3293-5282.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Wormfang Newt.
When Wormfang Newt dies, its second ability triggers, returning a Plains from exile to the battlefield.
When the Plains enters the battlefield, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Wormfang Newt from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Newt enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling a Plains.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1495-2180-4613.notablePrerequisites: Nearheath Stalker has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-2180-4613.description:
Activate Nearheath Stalker using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 until Nearheath Stalker has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve all Nearheath Stalker abilities dealing 1 damage to Nearheath Stalker, and any remaining damage to any target(s).
Nearheath Stalker dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Nearheath Stalker's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1912-3076-4289-4639.notablePrerequisites:
Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sleep-Cursed Faerie.
1912-3076-4289-4639.description:
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sleep-Cursed Faerie triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

851-2523-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Adrix and Nev does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
851-2523-4711.description:
Declare Adrix and Nev as an attacker.
Adrix and Nev's myriad ability triggers, creating two token copies of Adrix and Nev that are tapped and attacking each opponent.
Put all Adrix and Nev tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Adrix and Nev tokens die, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev equal to 2^(the number of Adrix and Nevs you control) that are 2/2 Zombies.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.

1479-3678-4543.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
1479-3678-4543.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
The Kor Ally enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

222-3719-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with base power eight or greater.
You control at least one Saproling.
222-3719-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer, causing target player to mill cards equal to their combined power.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Ruthless Technomancer enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Ruthless Technomancer trigger, causing you to sacrifice the nontoken creature with base power eight or greater and create at least eight Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, causing target player to mill cards equal to Slimefoot and Squee's power.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and the nontoken creature with base power eight or greater to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
If the nontoken creature has base power nine or greater, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

3169-4499-4659-5263.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding {C}{C}.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader enters the battlefield, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, causing it to return to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero enters the battlefield, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Repeat.

380-490-2440-2972.notablePrerequisites: You control a modified creature that can attack this turn.
380-490-2440-2972.description:
Cast Ganax by paying {4}{R}.
When Ganax enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, Mana Echoes and Miirym.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ganax.
When the token Ganax enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, the nontoken Ganax, and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve both Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Move to your combat phase, and declare any modified creature you control as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Activate Goro-Goro's second ability by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a 5/5 Dragon Spirit creature token with flying.
When the Dragon Spirit enters the battlefield, it triggers Mana Echoes and both Ganax.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve both Ganax triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 11.
Once you have infinite tokens, you may use Goro-Goro's first ability to give them haste.

305-1188-2232-2900.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic Forest.
Llanowar Tribe does not have summoning sickness.
305-1188-2232-2900.description:
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Quirion Ranger by paying {G}.
Quirion Ranger enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Elvish Pioneer from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Quirion Ranger by returning a basic Forest from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Cast Elvish Pioneer by paying {G}.
Elvish Pioneer enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Elvish Pioneer trigger, putting a basic Forest from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Quirion Ranger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2302-3082-4215.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Triumph of Saint Katherine, adding {C}{C}.
Triumph of Saint Katherine dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Triumph of Saint Katherine trigger, exiling it and the top six cards of your library into a face-down pile, then shuffling that pile and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Triumph of Saint Katherine and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

3518-4401-4986.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Restoration Specialist by paying {W} and sacrificing it, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Restoration Specialist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

813-1777-5188.description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding seven mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}.
Cast Dread Return by paying {2}{B}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Scholar of the Ages triggers, returning Burnt Offering and Dread Return from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
